With our review of the best Tailwind CSS admin and dashboard templates, you can enjoy a quick app development process.

We’ve expanded this collection to include 20 outstanding Tailwind CSS templates that stand out for their design quality, functionality, and developer experience. From free open-source options to premium solutions, these templates offer everything you need to build modern, responsive web applications.

You don’t need to begin working on your project by paying a fee immediately. Enjoy the free solutions, which have many practical elements and components.

Note: Some templates have the same name, but the technologies differ. So that they don’t cause any confusion.

Build a powerful admin with a ready-to-use dashboard template that will unlock the true potential of your application.

Best Tailwind CSS Templates

1. Notus React


This is the React version of the Tailwind CSS template for kick-starting the production of an admin panel. Of course, free of charge.

Notus React has well over 6,500 downloads and 5/5 ratings, which tells more than enough about its quality.

Even though it costs nothing, it still comes with one hundred components, three plugins, and nine example pages.

The layout follows all the modern web trends to ensure outstanding performance. Read: responsive and mobile-ready.

Download Preview

2. Notus NextJS


This powerful Tailwind CSS, NextJS UI kit, and admin template will do you well. Notus NextJS is all set to set you on the right track immediately.

The bundle of goodies is just a click away, readily available to put into practice. You don’t always need to pay a hefty fee to make great things happen.

We also like Notus NextJS’s regular updates, community support, and practical elements. You can even share a comment on the product page. Someone will surely get back to you.

Download Preview

3. Vue Notus


This collection of the best Tailwind CSS admin and dashboard templates ensures there’s something for everyone. There’s no need to do your research; simply choose from the list, and you’re good to go.

As the name suggests, Vue Notus also uses VueJS and comes as both a UI kit and an admin template. With this in mind, you already know there will be quite a few components, plugins, and pages you can work with. 100 + 3 + 9 = 112! Yes, 112 in total!

Download Preview

4. Notus Angular


You know that all these templates require coding, but you may not be aware that the basics are more than enough. Notus Angular and all the other tools are coded with beginners in mind, which is great for experts.

Quick prototyping is just around the corner. However, Notus Angular also works especially to build an actual admin dashboard for your new (or existing) web application.

Thousands of users are already enjoying Notus Angular’s perks (Tailwind CSS + Angular), and we’re sure you’ll benefit greatly from them, too.

Download Preview

5. Notus Svelte


Notus Svelte is a modern and catchy Tailwind CSS admin and dashboard template with 5-star reviews and over 1.5k downloads. Yes, it’s free, and you can enjoy it immediately. But you can check the live demo preview first and go from there.

Notus Svelte is ready to rock and roll with over one hundred components at your disposal.

You can even modify individual elements or use the out-of-the-box version. Last but not least, the template is compatible with modern devices and web browsers to ensure a great experience and performance.

Download Preview

6. Material Tailwind Kit


Here, we have a full-blown kit that uses Tailwind CSS and React technologies. It is free and open-source, so you are welcome to modify it according to your liking.

It is a free package with 120 elements and four example pages. You can mix and match the available stuff however you want. In addition, you can customize each element or simply go with the default configurations.

You have many options and possibilities to start developing your new web applications comfortably. Get involved!

Download Preview

7. Material Tailwind Dashboard


If the above one was a Material kit, this one is an exclusive Material dashboard. Building an admin panel for your project doesn’t necessarily mean tedious work and long hours behind the code.

You can kick things off with confidence and without spending a dime. Material Tailwind Dashboard may cost you nothing, but it promises a remarkable outcome with quick development time.

The bundle offers five color skins and numerous components you can use and reuse. If you are not a picky user, you will enjoy working with the out-of-the-box version – that’s a promise.

Download Preview

8. Yeti Admin


Yeti Admin is a modern Tailwind CSS admin template with an XD design file. It also includes a starter kit, so working on new projects will be much easier and faster.

Some features are dark mode, ready-to-use pages and apps, different menu styles, and more. You can take as much time as necessary to investigate Yeti Admin further by accessing the live demo preview.

But if you are looking for a minimalist dashboard that screams “Simplicity,” this is likely the template for you. We enjoyed reviewing every single detail!

Download Preview

9. Midone


Midone is one of the templates available in many different formats and technologies. Yes, it also comes as a Tailwind CSS admin dashboard template.

The tool is clean, modern and professional. You can comfortably boost your workflow while still maintaining your expert level. This gives you all this extra time to apply to other projects or market your existing one.

The great coding base ensures great adaptation to your needs and regulations. But you can also first review all the available layouts, themes and components, as there a good chance you’ll want to use them as-is.

Wondering what others have created using Tailwind? Here are some incredible websites examples build using Tailwind CSS.

Download Preview

10. TailAdmin – Free Tailwind CSS Admin Dashboard

⭐ 1.2k GitHub Stars

Why we like it: TailAdmin stands out as the most comprehensive free Tailwind CSS admin template available, offering seven uniquely designed dashboard variations for Analytics, E-commerce, Marketing, and CRM applications.

TailAdmin provides developers with everything needed to create a complete, data-driven back-end, dashboard, or admin panel solution. Available for HTML, React, Next.js, Vue, and Angular, this template includes an extensive collection of handcrafted Dashboard UI components.

Download Preview

11. Material Tailwind Dashboard React

⭐ 1.8k GitHub Stars

Why we like it: Perfect blend of Material Design principles with Tailwind CSS utility classes, created by the renowned Creative Tim team.

Material Tailwind Dashboard React is Creative Tim’s newest free Material Tailwind Admin Template based on Tailwind CSS and React. Built with over 40 frontend individual elements from @material-tailwind/react.

Download Preview

12. Trezo – Multi-Framework Admin Dashboard

⭐ Premium Template

Why we like it: Unprecedented framework support with 30 industry-specific dashboard variations, making it suitable for any project type.

Trezo is a modern, multipurpose admin dashboard template supporting React, Next.js, Angular, Vue/Nuxt, Laravel, ASP.NET Core, Django, Rails, and more. It ships with 30 industry dashboards for SaaS, CRM, analytics, fintech, healthcare, real estate, education, and logistics.

Download Preview

13. Shadcn Admin Dashboard

⭐ 2.3k GitHub Stars

Why we like it: Built with the incredibly popular Shadcn/ui component library, offering a modern and accessible design system.

Shadcn Admin is a reusable admin dashboard built with Shadcn/ui and Vite. This template provides a clean, modern interface with excellent accessibility features. Built with Next.js, React, and the shadcn/ui component library.

Download Preview

14. Preline UI Admin Template

⭐ 4.2k GitHub Stars

Why we like it: Comprehensive component library with over 740 pre-built templates and excellent framework compatibility.

Preline UI offers a modern Admin CMS dashboard for managing posts, members, and site content with ease. Features comprehensive overview with charts, tables, and a streamlined dashboard layout for easy data visualization and analysis.

Download Preview

15. HyperUI Components Collection

⭐ 9.8k GitHub Stars

Why we like it: Cutting-edge Tailwind CSS v4 compatibility with over 226 free components that you can copy and paste directly into your projects.

HyperUI is a collection of free Tailwind CSS v4 components designed to enhance web development with the latest features and styles. Features extensive component library with over 200 components including buttons, navbars, forms, cards, and pricing tables.

Download Preview

16. Shadcn/ui Dashboard Example

⭐ 71k GitHub Stars

Why we like it: Official example from the Shadcn/ui library, demonstrating best practices for building dashboards with their component system.

The official Shadcn/ui dashboard example showcases how to build beautiful, accessible dashboards using their component library. Built with React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS, this example provides a perfect starting point for creating modern admin interfaces.

Download Preview

17. Horizon UI Pro – Premium Tailwind Dashboard

⭐ 2.9k GitHub Stars

Why we like it: Described as the “fastest, most responsive & trendiest dashboard for Tailwind CSS” with over 400+ premium components.

Horizon UI Pro comes with over 400+ dark/light frontend individual elements, giving you complete freedom in choosing and combining components. Made of hundreds of elements, designed blocks and fully coded pages.

Download Preview

18. Preline Pro Dashboard

⭐ Premium Template

Why we like it: Professional-grade premium solution with AI chat templates, video call interfaces, and smart home dashboards.

Preline Pro offers advanced admin features with 3 new Admin, AI, and Video Call demos. Includes 35+ examples with modern conversational assistant design, real-time call app UI like Zoom, and immersive dashboard for managing connected devices.

Download Preview

19. Windmill Dashboard

⭐ 2.4k GitHub Stars

Why we like it: Beautiful dark theme with React and Vue versions, offering developers flexibility in framework choice.

Windmill Dashboard is a beautiful admin dashboard template built with Tailwind CSS. Available in both React and Vue versions, featuring elegant dark theme, responsive design, comprehensive charts and graphs, and modern development practices with TypeScript support.

Download Preview

20. Pocket – Tailwind UI Template

⭐ Official Tailwind UI

Why we like it: Official Tailwind UI template created by the makers of Tailwind CSS, ensuring top-notch design and code quality.

Pocket is an official Tailwind UI template designed for mobile apps and responsive web applications. Created by the team behind Tailwind CSS, this template showcases best practices for mobile-first design and responsive layouts.

Download Preview

Conclusion

These 20 Tailwind CSS templates represent the best options available in 2025, ranging from completely free open-source solutions to premium commercial offerings. Whether you’re building a simple admin panel or a complex SaaS application, you’ll find templates here that match your requirements and design preferences.

When choosing a template, consider factors such as your framework preference (React, Vue, Angular, or vanilla HTML), maintenance frequency, community support, and specific features you need. Free templates like TailAdmin and Shadcn Admin are excellent starting points, while premium options like Trezo and Preline Pro offer more comprehensive feature sets for enterprise applications.
